The aCCSL role will also serve as a site escalation point for investigator concerns, including those related to data integrity, patient safety or issues which are unresolved by the CRO, for example, ensuring that these are communicated to the appropriate Biogen responsible parties. As assigned, the aCCSL may interact with FSP resources and support monitoring operations.

title: Software Engineer, Silicon Design Methodology
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a software engineer to help build the design methodology, software abstractions, and infrastructure that enable a small silicon team to develop complex chips rapidly and with high confidence. You will turn evolving architecture and design needs into reusable tools and workflows that improve iteration speed, quality, and then apply those tools to help construct world-class silicon.

You’ll work closely across architecture, design, verification, performance modeling, and systems software. This role is well suited for an engineer who enjoys building high quality software and is motivated by the challenge of improving velocity and quality of the silicon development process.

In this role, you will:

- Develop and scale design methodologies for rapid first-party chip development and apply them to construct complex custom chips

- Create abstractions that allow hardware structures, configurations, experiments, and results to be represented consistently across tools.

- Automate high-value engineering workflows and improve their reproducibility, observability, testability, and ease of use.

- Partner with architects, RTL designers, verification engineers, compiler engineers, and systems software engineers to gather requirements and then implement solutions.

- Use methodology and tooling to identify design risks early, accelerate iteration, and improve confidence in performance and implementation tradeoffs.

- Contribute across multiple aspects of software and hardware development as the first-party silicon program and its development methodology evolve.

You might thrive in this role if:

- You have strong software engineering skills in C++, Python, Rust, or similar systems-oriented languages.

- You have experience building engineering infrastructure, developer tools, simulation frameworks, EDA/CAD tooling, compilers, or verification systems.

- You understand digital design and computer architecture well enough to translate silicon-development needs into useful software abstractions.

- Have experience integrating RTL and IP components into an SoC.

- You have designed APIs, object models, or data models for complex systems and care about extensibility, correctness, and usability.

- You are comfortable automating multi-stage workflows, building regression systems, and improving reproducibility across teams.

- You can reason across architecture, design, verification, performance modeling, and software boundaries.

- You enjoy partnering closely with domain experts and turning loosely defined engineering needs into durable tools and methodologies.

- You thrive in rapidly evolving environments and can balance immediate program needs with longer-term platform quality.

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to support satellite mechanical subsystem and payload development programs. This role is responsible for structural architecture layout, primary and secondary structure design, analysis, assembly, and test support, including detailed design definition of parts and assemblies, management of mechanical interfaces between subsystems, and the analysis reports, interface control drawings, and manufacturing documentation that accompany them. • Perform mechanical design and computer-aided modeling of space hardware, including final detailed design definition of parts and assemblies and management of mechanical interfaces between subsystems.

• Conduct structural, mechanical system, and satellite payload equipment layout studies to determine optimal system architecture in terms of simplicity, performance, mass, and cost.

• Develop and maintain mechanical and structural design documentation at system and equipment level: mechanical analysis reports, interface control drawings, tooling and fixturing, and manufacturing documentation.

• Support creation of developmental and qualification test procedures (vibration, shock, TVAC, assembly).

• Prepare and present the information required to conduct thorough design and readiness reviews with management and peers.

• Coordinate with manufacturing and production to ensure successful transfer of information and that efficient processes are understood and documented.

• Evaluate and champion new technologies and methods.  

Qualifications  

Education:

Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree is preferred.

Experience:

A minimum of 12 years of hands-on experience in mechanical design, integration, and testing of spacecraft and spacecraft components.  

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong technical skill in design of satellite assemblies for launch and on-orbit environments, as well as design for manufacturability.

• Experience using standard analytical tools and classical structural analysis methods to support sizing and trade studies.

• Knowledge of, or experience with, launch vehicle integration.

• Experience operating in a Windchill PLM environment.

• Advanced degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering.  

Soft Skills:

• Innovative and creative approach to problem solving, with a willingness to challenge the status quo.

• Demonstrated ability to work in a multidisciplinary team with other engineers.

• Ability to lead a small team while also carrying assignments autonomously.

• Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.  

Technology Stack:

• CAD: Siemens NX preferred; CATIA, SolidWorks, or CREO also considered.

• PLM / product data management: Windchill.

• Standard analytical tools and classical structural analysis methods for sizing and trade studies.  

Physical Requirements  

• Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.

• Willingness to travel 25%-50% of the time.
